artifacts.backend_detail: FLASH, one kernel, online softmax (running max + running sum). tile Br=64 Bc=64 D_TILE=128 threads=256 (8 warps), 8 KV blocks, 1 d-chunks, smem 86784 B. QK^T = nvcuda::wmma 16x16x16 half x half -> fp32 accumulator, K^T via a col_major matrix_b fragment; Q/K converted fp32->fp16 on the global->shared path (float4 read + __floats2half2_rn store -- __pipeline_memcpy_async cannot convert). Score staged through an fp32 smem tile (ld=68) because the wmma fragment element->(row,col) map is not part of the API and the row max/sum is per-row; sdtype=fp32 (fp32 accumulator used as-is). PV = register-tiled FFMA GEMM on the CUDA cores in TRUE fp32 (P fp32 x V fp32, 8x4 thread tile). No tf32: no wmma::precision::tf32 fragment is instantiated, because on sm_89 tf32 tensor and fp32 FFMA share the same 91.1 TFLOP/s dense peak, so tf32 would cost 13 mantissa bits for no throughput. Output accumulator is a plain float[1][32] register array (Br x d = 8192 floats / 256 threads) with an explicit (row,col) map so the per-row alpha rescale is legal; each PV product goes through a (Br,128) fp32 smem staging tile and is folded in as acc = acc*alpha + staged, identically for both pdtypes. Zero inline PTX (asserted at build).
